title: 矩阵乘、einsum 的典型写法与 np.ptp
expected_output:
A =
[[0 7 6 4]
 [4 8 0 6]
 [2 0 5 9]]
B =
[[7 7]
 [7 7]
 [5 1]
 [8 4]]
A @ B =
[[111  71]
 [132 108]
 [111  55]]
einsum 与 @ 结果一致 : True
--- einsum 的几种典型写法 ---
矩阵迹 einsum('ii->')  = 12
平方和 einsum('ij,ij->') = 327
外积   einsum('i,j->ij') =
[[10 20]
 [20 40]]
转置   einsum('ij->ji') 与 .T 一致 : True
--- ptp 极差 ---
np.ptp(x) = 8 | x.max()-x.min() = 8
code:
import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
A = rng.integers(0, 10, size=(3, 4))
B = rng.integers(0, 10, size=(4, 2))
print("A =")
print(A)
print("B =")
print(B)
prod = A @ B
print("A @ B =")
print(prod)
print("einsum 与 @ 结果一致 :", np.array_equal(prod, np.einsum("ij,jk->ik", A, B)))
print("--- einsum 的几种典型写法 ---")
eye = np.eye(4) * 3
print("矩阵迹 einsum('ii->')  =", int(np.einsum("ii->", eye)))
print("平方和 einsum('ij,ij->') =", int(np.einsum("ij,ij->", A, A)))
print("外积   einsum('i,j->ij') =")
print(np.einsum("i,j->ij", np.array([1, 2]), np.array([10, 20])))
print("转置   einsum('ij->ji') 与 .T 一致 :",
      np.array_equal(np.einsum("ij->ji", A), A.T))
print("--- ptp 极差 ---")
x = np.array([3, 1, 7, 2, 9])
print("np.ptp(x) =", int(np.ptp(x)), "| x.max()-x.min() =", int(x.max() - x.min()))
